title: Case: Returned parcel has reached the carrier depot but not the merchant warehouse
context: The return is in carrier transit, with no merchant receipt. Tracing should end in a warehouse confirmation rather than an inferred refund.
initial_request: My return has been sitting at the depot. Could you trace it to the merchant? I need to know when they actually have it.

events.body: RT-9442 last scan: return depot, 2028-03-04 07:40 UTC. No merchant receiving scan is visible. The carrier still holds the return.
My return has been sitting at the depot. Could you trace it to the merchant? I need to know when they actually have it.

events.to: Returns trace team, Saltmarrow Arc Logistics
events.body: Please trace RT-9442 through to merchant receipt. Ask the merchant receiving team to confirm physical acceptance rather than use a departure scan as proof.

events.from: Returns trace team, Saltmarrow Arc Logistics
events.body: FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Returns trace team, Saltmarrow Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Merchant physical receipt does not establish accepted condition, refund approval or payment.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-034: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
